# The Real Miami Dentists

> The Real Miami Dentists is a cosmetic dentistry education brand powered by 5 Star Smiles, a dental practice at 315 Alhambra Circle, Coral Gables, FL 33134. It explains what excellent cosmetic dentistry looks like and helps people see the difference between a white smile and a beautifully designed one.

- Practice: 5 Star Smiles
- Address: 315 Alhambra Circle, Coral Gables, FL 33134
- Phone: (305) 930-2400
- Email: info@iwanta5starsmile.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM
- Instagram and TikTok: @therealmiamidentists
- Treatments shown on the site: porcelain veneers (two visits), same-day resin veneers, 1-year warranty on smile designs
